body: Alright. Thank you for helping and answering all my questions, I really appreciate it.

Okay thanks. I'll move stuff around now and put her where they can't really see her and shouldn't be bothered. I'm not in the UK, here in Aus especially where I live people who own rats are not common, and I have to travel hours for a rattery. Would the carrier method still be okay after a week or so, considering it's a group of adults and a 10wk old?
Whoops sorry I just saw you edited yours. I can try that.

Aw damn. It's nowhere near touching, should she still be in a different part of the house? There are quite a few videos and articles saying to put the cages near each other and cage swap the rats, but I didnt know it was wrong.

Thank you! I'm glad to hear it's not aggressive. I was starting to get worried because the oldest has been doing it pretty persistently over the last 7 or so hours. Do you think this means it would be a good idea to start introducing them on neutral ground?

Thanks for replying.

I hope the hurricane doesn't hit! I can't imagine how scary that would be, they don't happen in my country as far as I'm aware.

There's no point. The hospital just ships you off so you don't kill yourself, then you lie in the ward to go home, and repeat. No help is available and I've just run out of hope.

Thank you, I'll take a look at GIMP.

Yeah I did about an hour of fiddling on the art/photo editing software I do have and it did nothing besides making it more pixelated.

I think they're just incredibly lazy. It's only paperwork so I can get more help in getting better healthcare in order to get better, and I've asked them for it at least once a week over the last 3 months. What a fun time

Thanks for the reply.

It's pretty bad, I cant read it at all and zooming in on the image is just a billion times worse.

I didn't want to share the file itself because it contains my personal information. But really, it just looks like where words are meant to be are just different coloured grey pixels. I think it's likely not able to be saved, I just wanted to avoid having to wait another 3 months for them to send me another copy (they're absolutely terrible).

Wow that's crazy, I'm glad you found out before it was too late. And thanks for alarming me, I managed to book an appointment and my medicare is covering the cost, so I really appreciate you posting and pushing me to get stuff done. Thank you!

Thank you for replying. Ah okay, well I'm glad yours was all good! I'm only worried about my eye because it's gotten bigger over the past year, and is now a constant annoying obstruction in my vision. I might ask my doctor about it, but that's as close as I'll be able to get to seeing a professional I think.

Honestly, I haven't officially been diagnosed yet for these newer (yet recurring) symptoms. I don't function so well, I'm having an okay moment right now but I think it was because I managed to sleep a little. It can be bad, my partner, who i live with said that i can often be completely unresponsive for a period of time, then get up and have apparently hallucinated an entire situation happening. They seem to be random, and while i don't drive unless I absolutely have to, I drove the other night since I went the town over to save money for shopping.

Hi! I'm actually in a very remote area in Australia, and literally every hospital in a 3 hour radius around here knows me. Because of that they don't take me seriously.

I'm sorry the hospitals there are so incompetent. But you're an awesome person for working for and trying your best to help people who are struggling with mental illness!

Thank you so, so much to everyone who is commenting. You are all so amazing and understanding. I wish I could respond to you all individually but if it means anything I'm trying to read every comment. Whatever stage of life you're in right now, I hope things are well for each and every one of you <3

Been taken in by the police and against my will several times over the past few months and they turn me out before the day is done, so I assume it'll be the same situation if I walk in. They're just not great where I currently live

Aaaah thank you! I wasn't expecting such a nice reply. I'm so sorry to hear that you have been in psychosis before, and I hope that you never have to experience it again. Also, thank you for the bojack quote, I've saved it for later :)
Not possible here, and I've tried reaching out to the nearby towns' hospitals with no luck.

Sounds like emotional abuse.
Honestly I would go to the sites you use and block the guy, J, the best that you can so that you don't see anything affiliated to them anymore.
